title: WorldRadio
tagline: WorldRadio is an FM radio station where people from all over the world can equally broadcast their own voice.
description: WorldRadio manages broadcasting rights through smart contracts. Therefore, anyone who meets the rules specified in the smart contract can acquire broadcasting rights. Additionally, users who acquire broadcasting rights can send encrypted audio data to their devices using end-to-end encryption (E2EE).
